note: Ward numbers follow the January 2020 ward formation of the two corporations, Nagar Nigam Jodhpur Uttar (80 wards) and Dakshin (80 wards). In 2025 the state merged them into one Nagar Nigam Jodhpur with 100 wards; that gazette was not found on an official host on 10 Oct 2026, so these records describe the 2020-2025 wards.

sources.holds: Rajasthan Gazette, 6 Jan 2020, LSG order F.10 (Elec) LSG/20/3: ward formation of Municipal Corporation Jodhpur North. One row per new ward: serial, ward number, a column headed assembly name that only repeats the corporation name (not a seat), population, boundary description and localities. Hindi text, some letters garbled by PDF extraction.
